body.cap: A media delegation comprising 13 domestic and international outlets invited from Europe, the Americas, and Asia, along with the nine recipients of the FIX 2026 Innovation Awards ‘Best Innovation Technology Award’, gathered at the ‘FIX TV ZONE’ in EXCO West Wing, Daegu, to hold the ‘FIX 2026 Innovation Awards Media Day’ | Photo by AVING News

body.x: The ‘Future Innovation tech eXpo 2026 (FIX 2026)’ hosted the ‘FIX 2026 Innovation Awards Media Day’ on the 22nd at EXCO in Daegu.

Organized by FIX 2026 and co-hosted by official media partner AVING News, the ‘FIX Innovation Awards Best Innovation Technology Award Winners Media Day’ was attended by three domestic media outlets and ten prominent global media partners representing Europe, the Americas, and Asia. The event was established to introduce the core technologies and flagship products of the ‘Best Innovation Technology Award’ recipients and illuminate their competitive edge in global markets.

The ‘FIX 2026 Innovation Awards’ was established to identify and celebrate innovative technologies across future mobility, robotics, and AI/ICT. A total of 209 enterprises submitted entries this year, and following comprehensive evaluations by a judging panel of 26 domestic and international experts, 31 companies were selected: 9 recipients of the Best Innovation Technology Award and 22 recipients of the Innovation Award. The Best Innovation Technology Award was conferred upon four companies in future mobility, two in robotics, and three in AI/ICT.

During the Media Day, the nine award-winning enterprises introduced diverse cross-industry innovation cases spanning automotive software and autonomous driving in future mobility, precision manipulation and humanoid robotics, as well as data center cooling, manufacturing AI, and cybersecurity in AI/ICT through presentations and interactive Q&A sessions with the domestic and international press corps.

body.cap: International journalists listen to corporate presentations during the ‘FIX 2026 INNOVATION AWARDS’ Media Day | Photo by AVING News
Dimpal Bajwa, Deputy Editor of ET Manufacturing, asks a question during the ‘FIX 2026 INNOVATION AWARDS’ Media Day | Photo by AVING News

body.x: The 13-member press corps attending the FIX Innovation Awards Media Day included leading domestic channels—such as Dong-A Ilbo IT, tech media outlet CNET KOREA, and DENOISE—alongside major international tech publications: Léo Thévenet, Editor-in-Chief of Le Café du Geek (France); Juan Castromil, Editor-in-Chief of Clipset (Spain); Eliane Fiolet, Editor-in-Chief of Ubergizmo (USA); Davis Kim, Reporter for AVING USA (USA); Yoshioka Tomomi, CEO of Otaku Soken (Japan); Sherri Wang, Research Editor at DIGITIMES (Taiwan); Võ Hoàng Long, Deputy Editor-in-Chief of VietnamPlus (Vietnam); Stephanie Chen, Editor-in-Chief of ChinaByte (China); Dimpal Bajwa, Deputy Editor of ET Manufacturing (India); and Mubashar Aftab, Editor-in-Chief of Pokde.net (Malaysia).

Covering specialized domains ranging from consumer tech and IT to semiconductor and ICT supply chains, manufacturing automation, robotics, and AI, these outlets will report on the participating enterprises and technological trends at FIX 2026, creating opportunities to broaden touchpoints with global markets.
Future Mobility: From Automotive Software to Autonomous Driving and Radar Innovations

body.cap: ONEPREDICT, recipient of the ‘Best Innovation Technology Award’ in Future Mobility at the ‘FIX 2026 Innovation Awards’ | Photo by AVING News

body.x: ONEPREDICT – AI-Based Industrial Equipment and Process Diagnostics

ONEPREDICT showcased its AI-driven predictive technology that analyzes the operational health of industrial equipment and detects anomalies in advance. By leveraging equipment datasets to preempt failure risks, the solution focuses on enhancing operational efficiency and systemic stability across manufacturing sites.

body.cap: SWM, recipient of the ‘Best Innovation Technology Award’ in Future Mobility at the ‘FIX 2026 Innovation Awards’ | Photo by AVING News

body.x: SWM – Autonomous Urban Robotaxi Technology

SWM garnered strong interest for its autonomous robotaxi service, designed to transport passengers within urban environments. Built upon a proprietary autonomous driving platform alongside high-precision perception and decision-making technologies, SWM enhances operational safety on real-world roadways and is accelerating the commercialization of autonomous mobility services.

body.cap: PERSEUS, recipient of the ‘Best Innovation Technology Award’ in Future Mobility at the ‘FIX 2026 Innovation Awards’ | Photo by AVING News

body.x: PERSEUS – Hypervisor Solution ‘Pegasus’ for SDVs

PERSEUS was honored with the Best Innovation Technology Award for ‘Pegasus’, a foundational hypervisor solution engineered for software-defined vehicles (SDVs). The technology enables the unified operation of diverse in-vehicle software stacks and electronic control functions, boosting both efficiency and architectural flexibility across automotive electronics.

body.cap: HJWAVE, recipient of the ‘Best Innovation Technology Award’ in Future Mobility at the ‘FIX 2026 Innovation Awards’ | Photo by AVING News

body.x: HJWAVE Co., Ltd. – 3D Waveguide Antenna

HJWAVE presented its 3D waveguide antenna technology, a mission-critical component in automotive radar modules utilized for autonomous navigation and advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS). Leveraging millimeter-wave (mmWave) RF technology to bolster radar transmission and reception capabilities, it enhances precision perception performance across next-generation mobility platforms.
Robotics: Precision Manipulation and Bipedal Humanoid Systems

body.cap: Tesollo, recipient of the ‘Best Innovation Technology Award’ in Robotics at the ‘FIX 2026 Innovation Awards’ | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Tesollo Co., Ltd. – Multi-Joint Robot Hand ‘DG-5F-M’

Tesollo secured the Best Innovation Technology Award in robotics for its multi-joint robotic hand ‘DG-5F-M’, which replicates the intricate dexterous motions of human hands. By utilizing articulated five-finger kinematics to grasp and manipulate diverse unstructured objects, the solution enables versatile applications across industrial automation and precision humanoid tasks.

body.cap: AeiROBOT, recipient of the ‘Best Innovation Technology Award’ in Robotics at the ‘FIX 2026 Innovation Awards’ | Photo by AVING News

body.x: AeiROBOT – Bipedal Humanoid Robot ‘Alice 5’

AeiROBOT’s ‘Alice 5’ is a bipedal humanoid robot designed to perform a wide range of physical tasks. Integrating differentiated actuation architectures across its upper and lower body, it secures both locomotion stability and operational dexterity, engineered to expand its functional utility across varied working environments.
AI/ICT: From Data Center Cooling to Manufacturing AI and Cybersecurity

body.cap: CENS, recipient of the ‘Best Innovation Technology Award’ in AI/ICT at the ‘FIX 2026 Innovation Awards’ | Photo by AVING News

body.x: CENS Co., Ltd. – AI-Controlled Precision Spray Cooling System

CENS introduced a precision spray-cooling system engineered to efficiently manage the thermal loads generated by AI servers. Using non-conductive dielectric cooling fluids to directly manage server heat, the system dynamically modulates cooling performance according to workload via real-time Thermal Design Power (TDP) tracking and variable-frequency drive (VFD) controls.

body.cap: WACE, recipient of the ‘Best Innovation Technology Award’ in AI/ICT at the ‘FIX 2026 Innovation Awards’ | Photo by AVING News

body.x: WACE Co., Ltd. – Manufacturing AI Operating System ‘VEXPLOR’

WACE was selected for its industrial AI software that analyzes factory-floor data to support production line management. Delivering responsive process adjustments and operational efficiency via AI-powered analytics and control, the platform demonstrates a pathway toward digital transformation and AI-driven autonomous manufacturing operations.

body.cap: POTATONET, recipient of the ‘Best Innovation Technology Award’ in AI/ICT at the ‘FIX 2026 Innovation Awards’ | Photo by AVING News

body.x: POTATONET – AI-Based Cyber Threat Intelligence Solution

POTATONET earned the Best Innovation Technology Award for its cybersecurity technology that harnesses AI to detect malicious online domains and cyber threats. By identifying and mitigating security risks across diverse digital ecosystems, the platform helps enterprises and end users safeguard critical digital assets.

An official noted, “This Media Day serves not only to publicize the technical accomplishments of the award recipients, but also to substantially broaden domestic and international media visibility and open global business collaboration avenues. Through on-site coverage and subsequent reporting by the international press corps, we hope that the technological prowess of South Korea’s innovative enterprises is prominently conveyed to overseas markets, translating into new business opportunities.”

Meanwhile, marking its third edition, FIX 2026 (Future Innovation tech eXpo 2026) is a future industry exhibition converging cutting-edge technologies across future mobility, robotics, AI/ICT, and startups, held from Wednesday, October 21 to Saturday, October 24 at EXCO in Daegu. Under the theme “AI, Beyond Tech into Reality,” the event highlights AI-driven innovations, global conferences, and business networking programs to share frontline industrial trends and core technologies.
